answer: In a decentralized AI consensus network, the Ivory Quill Protocol employs a hierarchical voting mechanism to resist fake-identity attacks. Agents are organized on a virtual terrace, with each agent holding a unique digital quill that verifies their identity. As agents cast votes, their quills are checked against a public ledger, ensuring that only genuine agents can participate. If an attacker attempts to create multiple identities, their quills will be flagged as duplicates, preventing them from casting multiple votes and compromising the network's integrity.
